bull.b: Progression into higher-dose cohorts provides important clinical validation for PGN-EDODM1 and creates defined data milestones through 2027. Continued advancement could strengthen the lead program’s regulatory and partnering prospects if efficacy and safety remain supportive.

PepGen’s EDO platform is designed to improve delivery of nucleic acid therapies to muscle and other tissues. Demonstrated biological activity and expansion into additional neuromuscular indications could support a broader, durable development pipeline.

The reported cash position and runway into late 2027 give PepGen time to generate multiple clinical readouts before needing additional financing. Reduced research spending and a narrower quarterly loss also improve near-term capital allocation flexibility.

bear.b: PepGen remains entirely dependent on clinical development rather than recurring product sales. With no approved therapies or visible top-line traction, fundamental value depends on future trial success, regulatory approval and eventual commercialization.

The business is not self-funding and requires substantial ongoing investment to advance its pipeline. Even though burn improved versus prior years, persistent negative free cash flow creates continued reliance on external financing over the development cycle.

Large recurring losses continue to reduce the company’s capital base and produce deeply negative returns on equity. If clinical spending remains high or capital markets become less accessible, future financing could increase dilution and constrain strategic flexibility.
